raw_text: India Today's OSINT desk has independently verified the existence of a coordinated influence operation targeting the 2024 general elections. Analysis of over 500 social media accounts reveals a pattern consistent with state-sponsored information operations. The accounts were created in bursts, share identical content within minutes, and predominantly target swing constituencies in Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and West Bengal.
clean_text: India Today OSINT desk verified coordinated influence operation targeting 2024 elections. Over 500 accounts showing state-sponsored patterns targeting swing constituencies.
